description: Solar potential is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Bristol City Council. This dataset shows an assessment of the suitability of building roofs for the installation of solar panels, within Bristol. This includes a general indication of the suitability and an estimate of the amount of power that could be generated from the roof area. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are Bristol City Council, local information, Solar, Renewable energy, Energy. The portal shows 158,148 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Upon accessing the Licensed Data you will be deemed to have accepted the terms of the Public Sector End User Licence - INSPIRE (https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/documents/licensing/inspire-end-user-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
